verdict.rationale: Statsig documents feature gates that toggle behavior in real time without a deploy, including an emergency kill switch. A first-feature tutorial creates a gate and checks it live with the JavaScript SDK, the quickstart claims only a few lines of code, and the free tier includes feature flags, so a new user can start without a paid plan. One community user said they spent quite some time setting up an integration, which weakens the 'within minutes' claim but does not contradict the documented capability. Missing for 10: hands-on or independent corroboration of a minutes-scale time from signup to a live production toggle, and explicit documentation of the signup-to-first-flag flow.
